pages.title: About us
pages.body:
Who We Are & What We Do

We are a dynamic organization dedicated to harnessing the influence of sports for positive change. Through a range of programs and initiatives, our goal is to elevate individuals, encourage community involvement, and share the message of faith.

We Proclaim the Gospel: Communicate and share the message of salvation through sports ministry activities.

We Make Disciples: Nurturing and ensuring individuals grow as committed followers of Christ.

We Obey the Bible: Uphold the principles and teachings of the Bible while aligning actions and decisions with biblical values.

Our Mission & Vision

The mission of the GSM is to partner with organizations, churches, communities and individuals to serve Christ's Kingdom in the world of sport and play. The vision of the Movement is to make disciples for Christ in the world of sport and play.
